cards.card: Platinum up to 35 month Balance Transfer

note: The main banks: Barclaycard (Barclays), NatWest and HSBC UK, three of the UK's largest retail banks and card issuers. Lloyds Bank was tried first and its site answered an automated request only with an error page, so it isn't written. Every personal card each bank lists, each read from its own summary box on 2026-10-30: Barclaycard's nine summary boxes on its site and the Amazon Barclaycard's (July 2025, the one its page links); NatWest's eight; HSBC UK's seven. Each card's standard purchase rate is written as the yearly rate the box states as its compound (effective) equivalent, with the range where the bank prices each holder within one (NatWest's and HSBC's 'from ... to'); the monthly and simple rates aren't written separately. A 0% introductory purchase rate is written for its months ('up to' a number written at that number; NatWest's Purchase and Balance Transfer card's '12 to 23 months' at 12, the least it promises). Cash: the cash rate's compound equivalent and the cash fee (a share with its minimum). The non-sterling transaction fee on purchases (Barclaycard Rewards: none on purchases; NatWest's Credit Card, Reward Black and Travel Reward: 0%). The minimum repayment: Barclaycard and NatWest ask the highest of £5, 1% plus the month's interest and fees, and their other figures; HSBC the highest of interest and default charges plus 1%, 2.5% of the balance, and £5: written as 1% plus interest with a £5 floor (HSBC's 2.5% option isn't modelled). The interest-free period: the maximum days the box gives. Default fees: Barclaycard's £12 late payment (its over-limit and returned payment fees are £0); NatWest charges no late or over-limit fee (£0); HSBC's £12 late, £12 over-limit and £5 returned payment. Annual and monthly fees: the Barclaycard Avios Plus's £20 a month, NatWest's Reward (£24 a year; refunded with a Reward current account, which the game doesn't hold), Reward Black (£84) and HSBC's Premier World Elite (£290; additional cardholders' £60 not written). The HSBC Premier cards are for HSBC Premier customers and the Student card's limit is £250 to £500; neither condition is written. Balance transfer, money transfer and instalment plan terms aren't written. Barclaycard's Amazon card is written from its summary box instead of the earlier reading of Barclaycard's card list (2026-10-29), which gave only its representative rate; that source is kept.
